Fix generateSchema() to output derived types for polymorphic single-object properties (#10799)

Previously, properties with className but without isArray (like maskSettings) were
incorrectly treated as arrays in schemaType(), and generateSchemaProperty() only
output a simple $ref without including derived types.

Changes:
- schemaType(): Only return "array" when isArray is explicitly true
- generateSchemaProperty(): Generate oneOf with base and all derived classes for
  polymorphic single-object properties (e.g. maskSettings now includes masksettings,
  patternmask, numericmask, datetimemask, currencymask)

Fixes schema generation for maskSettings and similar polymorphic properties.

Layout elements refactoring (#11282)

* Layout elements refactoring

* Layout element models

* Fix progressText and progressValue to use lazy getters

The SurveyProgressTextModel was using @property() decorators for progressText and progressValue, but the UI components access these as getters. Changed them to use getPropertyValue() with lazy evaluation like ProgressButtons does, ensuring proper reactivity and caching.

* Fix progressText and progressValue to use lazy getters

The previous commit incorrectly changed the progress layout elements
to return `this` (the SurveyProgressTextModel) instead of `this.survey`.
This caused UI test failures because the progress components expect
the survey instance to access properties like progressText and css.

* Initial plan

* Fix Boolean swapOrder keyboard navigation

When swapOrder is true, the visual order is reversed (Yes on left, No on right).
The keyboard navigation now respects this visual order:
- ArrowLeft selects the left option (Yes when swapOrder=true)
- ArrowRight selects the right option (No when swapOrder=true)

Fixes accessibility issue where pressing Left arrow unexpectedly selected No
when it was visually on the right side.

Expression variables are resolved case-insensitively ({parentpanel.q1}
matches the parentPanel context variable), but the changed-keys check
used by the visibleIf/enableIf/requiredIf dependency-skip compared names
case-sensitively. A question inside a nested dynamic panel with
visibleIf "{parentpanel.q1} ..." was not re-evaluated when the parent
panel value changed.

- getContextKeys: register lower-case aliases for context variable names
- getFirstNameByKeys: fall back to a lower-case key lookup per path step

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Remove settings.getElementId

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

matches the parentPanel context variable), but the changed-keys check
used by the visibleIf/enableIf/requiredIf dependency-skip compared names
case-sensitively. A question inside a nested dynamic panel with
visibleIf "{parentpanel.q1} ..." was not re-evaluated when the parent
panel value changed.

per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Refactor element ID handling to use uniqueId and renderedId for consistency across components

* Remove settings.getElementId

* Remove survey.renderedIdSuffix

* Refactor ActionContainer to manage locOwner and ensure deterministic SSR rendering

survey-core/linter - static analysis of survey logic (#11735)

* Add comprehensive linter tests for survey validation rules

- Implement tests for rendering findings in linter-renderer tests.
- Create linter rules tests covering various reference and naming issues.
- Add structure tests to validate page and element configurations.
- Introduce syntax tests for expression parsing and error reporting.
- Develop trigger tests to ensure proper validation of trigger targets.
- Add type mismatch tests to check for expression type compatibility.
- Implement walker tests to verify path normalization and index building.
- Create a TypeScript configuration for linter tests.

* Refactor linter to use Maps and Sets for type definitions and improve prototype key safety in CIMap and CIMultiMap

* Enhance linter to support dotted names in references and add corresponding tests

* feat(linter): enhance linting capabilities with new settings and function resolution

- Introduced ILintFunctionsProvider and ILintSettingsOverrides interfaces for better customization.
- Added resolveLintSettings and resolveLintFunctions functions to handle runtime options.
- Updated various linting rules to utilize new settings, improving type checking and choice validation.
- Enhanced expression type mismatch and unknown choice rules to support substring matching for scalar questions.
- Implemented tests for new functionalities, including custom suffix handling and imagemap question validation.
- Refactored existing linting logic to accommodate new settings structure and improve maintainability.

* fix(linter): lint validators declared with the full expressionvalidator type name

The runtime serializer accepts both "expression" and the full class name
"expressionvalidator", but the walker only recognized the short form, so
expressions in the long-form validators were silently never analyzed.

* fix(linter): detect trigger cycles that flow through a question valueName

Trigger edges were matched by raw strings, so a trigger setting "q1" never
linked to another trigger reading {v1} when v1 is the valueName of q1 -
a genuine runtime cascade went unreported. Both edge endpoints are now
canonicalized to the resolved element name.

* fix(linter): lint expressions inside composite component definitions

Elements passed via options.components elementsJSON were only harvested for
field names; their own visibleIf/enableIf/validator expressions were never
parsed or checked, so typos like {composite.fist} produced no diagnostics.
The walker now creates expression sites for definition elements with a
composite scope frame, finally constructing the previously dead
ScopeFrameComposite that the resolver already supported.

* fix(linter): report unknown trigger types instead of silently skipping them

A trigger whose type is not in the catalog was half-processed: only its
expression was scanned, while setToName targets, cycle detection, and extra
expression props were skipped without any signal. A misspelled type is also
silently dropped by the runtime. The new trigger/unknown-type rule reports
such triggers with a closest-match suggestion.

* refactor(linter): share duplicated helpers across rules

equalsCI and isKnownVariable had per-file copies, and the "which BinaryOperand
side is the Variable, which the constant" extraction was pasted three times
with diverging instanceof and operator checks. They now live in
expression-utils (matchVariableComparison, isPlainConst, getConstValues,
buildTriggerSetStep); choices-dead-source uses CIMultiMap.has instead of an
inline lowercase scan.

* fix(linter): parse reference indexes like the runtime ValueGetter

splitRefSegments claimed to mirror ValueGetter.getPath but read "[n]" indexes
with parseInt, so hex, comma decimals, exponents, and the >15-digit guard were
resolved differently than at runtime ({q[0x2]} meant index 2 for the engine and
0 for the linter). It now delegates to getPath. The import allowlist gains
conditionProcessValue, whose runtime dependencies are helpers and settings only,
so the linter still constructs no survey model.

* fix(linter): resolve trigger targets through the shared reference resolver

The rule reimplemented the byName/byValueName/calculatedValues/knownVariables
chain and its own indexed sub-path check, so it had already drifted from
classifyRef: dotted target names were falsely reported, and "-total"/"-Comment"
data keys resolved in expressions but not as trigger targets. Targets now go
through classifyTargetName, a name-mode entry point that skips expression-only
sugar (":" skipping, unwrap postfix, trailing ".length", scope prefixes) while
sharing the resolution chain and validateElementSubPath - which also extends
sub-path checking to multipletext, matrix, matrixdropdown, and component fields.
Navigation targets still resolve by name only, and suggestions stay kind-filtered.

Known gap: walker still derives trigger setRoot with a naive split, so dotted
setToName roots remain approximate for cycle/trigger canonicalization.

* refactor(linter): compute carry-forward paths at the report site

ChoicesInfo carried three path fields that were just record.path plus the
property name, and the walker set them only for selectbase questions - so
matrix columns fell back to the bare column path and reported their dead
carry-forward reference without naming the property. The paths are now
derived where they are reported, which removes the three fields and fixes
the column paths.

* refactor(linter): drop dead ElementRecord and ContainerRecord fields

ElementRecord.matrixColumnValues was declared but never written or read, and
ContainerRecord.json was populated at every container site while no rule ever
read it, pinning whole JSON subtrees for no consumer.

* refactor: streamline linter imports and settings handling

- Consolidated imports from "survey-core" in linter modules to reduce redundancy.
- Removed unnecessary interfaces for lint settings and functions, simplifying the configuration process.
- Updated lint settings resolution to directly use shared settings from "survey-core".
- Enhanced tests to utilize new settings handling, ensuring proper restoration after modifications.
- Added tests for legacy trigger expressions to ensure parity with runtime behavior.
- Introduced helper functions for managing settings and functions in tests, improving test clarity and maintainability.
- Updated Rollup configuration for linter to ensure proper external dependencies and typings.

* Refactor linter to support item-level conditions and improve carry-forward resolution

- Moved `choicesVisibleIf` and `choicesEnableIf` conditions to a new `MATRIX_COLUMN_ITEMVALUE_PROPS` for item-level evaluations in matrix columns.
- Enhanced `resolveCarryForwardSource` to handle row and panel prefixes, allowing for better resolution of choices in dynamic panels and matrix rows.
- Updated linter rules to correctly identify valid carry-forward sources and improve error reporting for dead sources.
- Added tests to ensure proper linting behavior for item-level conditions and carry-forward scenarios.
- Improved handling of comment suffixes in matrix rows and dynamic panels, ensuring they resolve correctly.
- Adjusted self-reference checks to account for matrix columns and template questions sharing names with top-level questions.

* feat: enhance linter functionality and metadata handling

- Implement runtime metadata reading for the linter, allowing dynamic analysis of registered properties and types.
- Introduce LintMetadata class to manage expression properties, trigger definitions, and element types.
- Update linter tests to validate new metadata functionality, including custom properties and composite components.
- Refactor existing tests to ensure compatibility with the new metadata-driven approach.
- Add tests for handling unknown types, expression properties, and custom conditions in the linter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Refactor element ID handling to use uniqueId and renderedId for consistency across components

* Remove settings.getElementId

* Remove survey.renderedIdSuffix

* Refactor ActionContainer to manage locOwner and ensure deterministic SSR rendering

survey-core/linter - static analysis of survey logic (#11735)

* Add comprehensive linter tests for survey validation rules

- Implement tests for rendering findings in linter-renderer tests.
- Create linter rules tests covering various reference and naming issues.
- Add structure tests to validate page and element configurations.
- Introduce syntax tests for expression parsing and error reporting.
- Develop trigger tests to ensure proper validation of trigger targets.
- Add type mismatch tests to check for expression type compatibility.
- Implement walker tests to verify path normalization and index building.
- Create a TypeScript configuration for linter tests.

* Refactor linter to use Maps and Sets for type definitions and improve prototype key safety in CIMap and CIMultiMap

* Enhance linter to support dotted names in references and add corresponding tests

* feat(linter): enhance linting capabilities with new settings and function resolution

- Introduced ILintFunctionsProvider and ILintSettingsOverrides interfaces for better customization.
- Added resolveLintSettings and resolveLintFunctions functions to handle runtime options.
- Updated various linting rules to utilize new settings, improving type checking and choice validation.
- Enhanced expression type mismatch and unknown choice rules to support substring matching for scalar questions.
- Implemented tests for new functionalities, including custom suffix handling and imagemap question validation.
- Refactored existing linting logic to accommodate new settings structure and improve maintainability.

* fix(linter): lint validators declared with the full expressionvalidator type name

The runtime serializer accepts both "expression" and the full class name
"expressionvalidator", but the walker only recognized the short form, so
expressions in the long-form validators were silently never analyzed.

* fix(linter): detect trigger cycles that flow through a question valueName

Trigger edges were matched by raw strings, so a trigger setting "q1" never
linked to another trigger reading {v1} when v1 is the valueName of q1 -
a genuine runtime cascade went unreported. Both edge endpoints are now
canonicalized to the resolved element name.

* fix(linter): lint expressions inside composite component definitions

Elements passed via options.components elementsJSON were only harvested for
field names; their own visibleIf/enableIf/validator expressions were never
parsed or checked, so typos like {composite.fist} produced no diagnostics.
The walker now creates expression sites for definition elements with a
composite scope frame, finally constructing the previously dead
ScopeFrameComposite that the resolver already supported.

* fix(linter): report unknown trigger types instead of silently skipping them

A trigger whose type is not in the catalog was half-processed: only its
expression was scanned, while setToName targets, cycle detection, and extra
expression props were skipped without any signal. A misspelled type is also
silently dropped by the runtime. The new trigger/unknown-type rule reports
such triggers with a closest-match suggestion.

* refactor(linter): share duplicated helpers across rules

equalsCI and isKnownVariable had per-file copies, and the "which BinaryOperand
side is the Variable, which the constant" extraction was pasted three times
with diverging instanceof and operator checks. They now live in
expression-utils (matchVariableComparison, isPlainConst, getConstValues,
buildTriggerSetStep); choices-dead-source uses CIMultiMap.has instead of an
inline lowercase scan.

* fix(linter): parse reference indexes like the runtime ValueGetter

splitRefSegments claimed to mirror ValueGetter.getPath but read "[n]" indexes
with parseInt, so hex, comma decimals, exponents, and the >15-digit guard were
resolved differently than at runtime ({q[0x2]} meant index 2 for the engine and
0 for the linter). It now delegates to getPath. The import allowlist gains
conditionProcessValue, whose runtime dependencies are helpers and settings only,
so the linter still constructs no survey model.

* fix(linter): resolve trigger targets through the shared reference resolver

The rule reimplemented the byName/byValueName/calculatedValues/knownVariables
chain and its own indexed sub-path check, so it had already drifted from
classifyRef: dotted target names were falsely reported, and "-total"/"-Comment"
data keys resolved in expressions but not as trigger targets. Targets now go
through classifyTargetName, a name-mode entry point that skips expression-only
sugar (":" skipping, unwrap postfix, trailing ".length", scope prefixes) while
sharing the resolution chain and validateElementSubPath - which also extends
sub-path checking to multipletext, matrix, matrixdropdown, and component fields.
Navigation targets still resolve by name only, and suggestions stay kind-filtered.

Known gap: walker still derives trigger setRoot with a naive split, so dotted
setToName roots remain approximate for cycle/trigger canonicalization.

* refactor(linter): compute carry-forward paths at the report site

ChoicesInfo carried three path fields that were just record.path plus the
property name, and the walker set them only for selectbase questions - so
matrix columns fell back to the bare column path and reported their dead
carry-forward reference without naming the property. The paths are now
derived where they are reported, which removes the three fields and fixes
the column paths.

* refactor(linter): drop dead ElementRecord and ContainerRecord fields

ElementRecord.matrixColumnValues was declared but never written or read, and
ContainerRecord.json was populated at every container site while no rule ever
read it, pinning whole JSON subtrees for no consumer.

* refactor: streamline linter imports and settings handling

- Consolidated imports from "survey-core" in linter modules to reduce redundancy.
- Removed unnecessary interfaces for lint settings and functions, simplifying the configuration process.
- Updated lint settings resolution to directly use shared settings from "survey-core".
- Enhanced tests to utilize new settings handling, ensuring proper restoration after modifications.
- Added tests for legacy trigger expressions to ensure parity with runtime behavior.
- Introduced helper functions for managing settings and functions in tests, improving test clarity and maintainability.
- Updated Rollup configuration for linter to ensure proper external dependencies and typings.

* Refactor linter to support item-level conditions and improve carry-forward resolution

- Moved `choicesVisibleIf` and `choicesEnableIf` conditions to a new `MATRIX_COLUMN_ITEMVALUE_PROPS` for item-level evaluations in matrix columns.
- Enhanced `resolveCarryForwardSource` to handle row and panel prefixes, allowing for better resolution of choices in dynamic panels and matrix rows.
- Updated linter rules to correctly identify valid carry-forward sources and improve error reporting for dead sources.
- Added tests to ensure proper linting behavior for item-level conditions and carry-forward scenarios.
- Improved handling of comment suffixes in matrix rows and dynamic panels, ensuring they resolve correctly.
- Adjusted self-reference checks to account for matrix columns and template questions sharing names with top-level questions.

* feat: enhance linter functionality and metadata handling

- Implement runtime metadata reading for the linter, allowing dynamic analysis of registered properties and types.
- Introduce LintMetadata class to manage expression properties, trigger definitions, and element types.
- Update linter tests to validate new metadata functionality, including custom properties and composite components.
- Refactor existing tests to ensure compatibility with the new metadata-driven approach.
- Add tests for handling unknown types, expression properties, and custom conditions in the linter.

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

survey-core/linter - static analysis of survey logic (#11735)

* Add comprehensive linter tests for survey validation rules

- Implement tests for rendering findings in linter-renderer tests.
- Create linter rules tests covering various reference and naming issues.
- Add structure tests to validate page and element configurations.
- Introduce syntax tests for expression parsing and error reporting.
- Develop trigger tests to ensure proper validation of trigger targets.
- Add type mismatch tests to check for expression type compatibility.
- Implement walker tests to verify path normalization and index building.
- Create a TypeScript configuration for linter tests.

* Refactor linter to use Maps and Sets for type definitions and improve prototype key safety in CIMap and CIMultiMap

* Enhance linter to support dotted names in references and add corresponding tests

* feat(linter): enhance linting capabilities with new settings and function resolution

- Introduced ILintFunctionsProvider and ILintSettingsOverrides interfaces for better customization.
- Added resolveLintSettings and resolveLintFunctions functions to handle runtime options.
- Updated various linting rules to utilize new settings, improving type checking and choice validation.
- Enhanced expression type mismatch and unknown choice rules to support substring matching for scalar questions.
- Implemented tests for new functionalities, including custom suffix handling and imagemap question validation.
- Refactored existing linting logic to accommodate new settings structure and improve maintainability.

* fix(linter): lint validators declared with the full expressionvalidator type name

The runtime serializer accepts both "expression" and the full class name
"expressionvalidator", but the walker only recognized the short form, so
expressions in the long-form validators were silently never analyzed.

* fix(linter): detect trigger cycles that flow through a question valueName

Trigger edges were matched by raw strings, so a trigger setting "q1" never
linked to another trigger reading {v1} when v1 is the valueName of q1 -
a genuine runtime cascade went unreported. Both edge endpoints are now
canonicalized to the resolved element name.

* fix(linter): lint expressions inside composite component definitions

Elements passed via options.components elementsJSON were only harvested for
field names; their own visibleIf/enableIf/validator expressions were never
parsed or checked, so typos like {composite.fist} produced no diagnostics.
The walker now creates expression sites for definition elements with a
composite scope frame, finally constructing the previously dead
ScopeFrameComposite that the resolver already supported.

* fix(linter): report unknown trigger types instead of silently skipping them

A trigger whose type is not in the catalog was half-processed: only its
expression was scanned, while setToName targets, cycle detection, and extra
expression props were skipped without any signal. A misspelled type is also
silently dropped by the runtime. The new trigger/unknown-type rule reports
such triggers with a closest-match suggestion.

* refactor(linter): share duplicated helpers across rules

equalsCI and isKnownVariable had per-file copies, and the "which BinaryOperand
side is the Variable, which the constant" extraction was pasted three times
with diverging instanceof and operator checks. They now live in
expression-utils (matchVariableComparison, isPlainConst, getConstValues,
buildTriggerSetStep); choices-dead-source uses CIMultiMap.has instead of an
inline lowercase scan.

* fix(linter): parse reference indexes like the runtime ValueGetter

splitRefSegments claimed to mirror ValueGetter.getPath but read "[n]" indexes
with parseInt, so hex, comma decimals, exponents, and the >15-digit guard were
resolved differently than at runtime ({q[0x2]} meant index 2 for the engine and
0 for the linter). It now delegates to getPath. The import allowlist gains
conditionProcessValue, whose runtime dependencies are helpers and settings only,
so the linter still constructs no survey model.

* fix(linter): resolve trigger targets through the shared reference resolver

The rule reimplemented the byName/byValueName/calculatedValues/knownVariables
chain and its own indexed sub-path check, so it had already drifted from
classifyRef: dotted target names were falsely reported, and "-total"/"-Comment"
data keys resolved in expressions but not as trigger targets. Targets now go
through classifyTargetName, a name-mode entry point that skips expression-only
sugar (":" skipping, unwrap postfix, trailing ".length", scope prefixes) while
sharing the resolution chain and validateElementSubPath - which also extends
sub-path checking to multipletext, matrix, matrixdropdown, and component fields.
Navigation targets still resolve by name only, and suggestions stay kind-filtered.

Known gap: walker still derives trigger setRoot with a naive split, so dotted
setToName roots remain approximate for cycle/trigger canonicalization.

* refactor(linter): compute carry-forward paths at the report site

ChoicesInfo carried three path fields that were just record.path plus the
property name, and the walker set them only for selectbase questions - so
matrix columns fell back to the bare column path and reported their dead
carry-forward reference without naming the property. The paths are now
derived where they are reported, which removes the three fields and fixes
the column paths.

* refactor(linter): drop dead ElementRecord and ContainerRecord fields

ElementRecord.matrixColumnValues was declared but never written or read, and
ContainerRecord.json was populated at every container site while no rule ever
read it, pinning whole JSON subtrees for no consumer.

* refactor: streamline linter imports and settings handling

- Consolidated imports from "survey-core" in linter modules to reduce redundancy.
- Removed unnecessary interfaces for lint settings and functions, simplifying the configuration process.
- Updated lint settings resolution to directly use shared settings from "survey-core".
- Enhanced tests to utilize new settings handling, ensuring proper restoration after modifications.
- Added tests for legacy trigger expressions to ensure parity with runtime behavior.
- Introduced helper functions for managing settings and functions in tests, improving test clarity and maintainability.
- Updated Rollup configuration for linter to ensure proper external dependencies and typings.

* Refactor linter to support item-level conditions and improve carry-forward resolution

- Moved `choicesVisibleIf` and `choicesEnableIf` conditions to a new `MATRIX_COLUMN_ITEMVALUE_PROPS` for item-level evaluations in matrix columns.
- Enhanced `resolveCarryForwardSource` to handle row and panel prefixes, allowing for better resolution of choices in dynamic panels and matrix rows.
- Updated linter rules to correctly identify valid carry-forward sources and improve error reporting for dead sources.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Refactor element ID handling to use uniqueId and renderedId for consistency across components

* Remove settings.getElementId

* Remove survey.renderedIdSuffix

* Refactor ActionContainer to manage locOwner and ensure deterministic SSR rendering

survey-core/linter - static analysis of survey logic (#11735)

* Add comprehensive linter tests for survey validation rules

- Implement tests for rendering findings in linter-renderer tests.
- Create linter rules tests covering various reference and naming issues.
- Add structure tests to validate page and element configurations.
- Introduce syntax tests for expression parsing and error reporting.
- Develop trigger tests to ensure proper validation of trigger targets.
- Add type mismatch tests to check for expression type compatibility.
- Implement walker tests to verify path normalization and index building.
- Create a TypeScript configuration for linter tests.

* Refactor linter to use Maps and Sets for type definitions and improve prototype key safety in CIMap and CIMultiMap

* Enhance linter to support dotted names in references and add corresponding tests

* feat(linter): enhance linting capabilities with new settings and function resolution

- Introduced ILintFunctionsProvider and ILintSettingsOverrides interfaces for better customization.
- Added resolveLintSettings and resolveLintFunctions functions to handle runtime options.
- Updated various linting rules to utilize new settings, improving type checking and choice validation.
- Enhanced expression type mismatch and unknown choice rules to support substring matching for scalar questions.
- Implemented tests for new functionalities, including custom suffix handling and imagemap question validation.
- Refactored existing linting logic to accommodate new settings structure and improve maintainability.

* fix(linter): lint validators declared with the full expressionvalidator type name

The runtime serializer accepts both "expression" and the full class name
"expressionvalidator", but the walker only recognized the short form, so
expressions in the long-form validators were silently never analyzed.

* fix(linter): detect trigger cycles that flow through a question valueName

Trigger edges were matched by raw strings, so a trigger setting "q1" never
linked to another trigger reading {v1} when v1 is the valueName of q1 -
a genuine runtime cascade went unreported. Both edge endpoints are now
canonicalized to the resolved element name.

* fix(linter): lint expressions inside composite component definitions

Elements passed via options.components elementsJSON were only harvested for
field names; their own visibleIf/enableIf/validator expressions were never
parsed or checked, so typos like {composite.fist} produced no diagnostics.
The walker now creates expression sites for definition elements with a
composite scope frame, finally constructing the previously dead
ScopeFrameComposite that the resolver already supported.

* fix(linter): report unknown trigger types instead of silently skipping them

A trigger whose type is not in the catalog was half-processed: only its
expression was scanned, while setToName targets, cycle detection, and extra
expression props were skipped without any signal. A misspelled type is also
silently dropped by the runtime. The new trigger/unknown-type rule reports
such triggers with a closest-match suggestion.

* refactor(linter): share duplicated helpers across rules

equalsCI and isKnownVariable had per-file copies, and the "which BinaryOperand
side is the Variable, which the constant" extraction was pasted three times
with diverging instanceof and operator checks. They now live in
expression-utils (matchVariableComparison, isPlainConst, getConstValues,
buildTriggerSetStep); choices-dead-source uses CIMultiMap.has instead of an
inline lowercase scan.

* fix(linter): parse reference indexes like the runtime ValueGetter

splitRefSegments claimed to mirror ValueGetter.getPath but read "[n]" indexes
with parseInt, so hex, comma decimals, exponents, and the >15-digit guard were
resolved differently than at runtime ({q[0x2]} meant index 2 for the engine and
0 for the linter). It now delegates to getPath. The import allowlist gains
conditionProcessValue, whose runtime dependencies are helpers and settings only,
so the linter still constructs no survey model.

* fix(linter): resolve trigger targets through the shared reference resolver

The rule reimplemented the byName/byValueName/calculatedValues/knownVariables
chain and its own indexed sub-path check, so it had already drifted from
classifyRef: dotted target names were falsely reported, and "-total"/"-Comment"
data keys resolved in expressions but not as trigger targets. Targets now go
through classifyTargetName, a name-mode entry point that skips expression-only
sugar (":" skipping, unwrap postfix, trailing ".length", scope prefixes) while
sharing the resolution chain and validateElementSubPath - which also extends
sub-path checking to multipletext, matrix, matrixdropdown, and component fields.
Navigation targets still resolve by name only, and suggestions stay kind-filtered.

Known gap: walker still derives trigger setRoot with a naive split, so dotted
setToName roots remain approximate for cycle/trigger canonicalization.

* refactor(linter): compute carry-forward paths at the report site

ChoicesInfo carried three path fields that were just record.path plus the
property name, and the walker set them only for selectbase questions - so
matrix columns fell back to the bare column path and reported their dead
carry-forward reference without naming the property. The paths are now
derived where they are reported, which removes the three fields and fixes
the column paths.

* refactor(linter): drop dead ElementRecord and ContainerRecord fields

ElementRecord.matrixColumnValues was declared but never written or read, and
ContainerRecord.json was populated at every container site while no rule ever
read it, pinning whole JSON subtrees for no consumer.

* refactor: streamline linter imports and settings handling

- Consolidated imports from "survey-core" in linter modules to reduce redundancy.
- Removed unnecessary interfaces for lint settings and functions, simplifying the configuration process.
- Updated lint settings resolution to directly use shared settings from "survey-core".
- Enhanced tests to utilize new settings handling, ensuring proper restoration after modifications.
- Added tests for legacy trigger expressions to ensure parity with runtime behavior.
- Introduced helper functions for managing settings and functions in tests, improving test clarity and maintainability.
- Updated Rollup configuration for linter to ensure proper external dependencies and typings.

* Refactor linter to support item-level conditions and improve carry-forward resolution

- Moved `choicesVisibleIf` and `choicesEnableIf` conditions to a new `MATRIX_COLUMN_ITEMVALUE_PROPS` for item-level evaluations in matrix columns.
- Enhanced `resolveCarryForwardSource` to handle row and panel prefixes, allowing for better resolution of choices in dynamic panels and matrix rows.
- Updated linter rules to correctly identify valid carry-forward sources and improve error reporting for dead sources.
- Added tests to ensure proper linting behavior for item-level conditions and carry-forward scenarios.
- Improved handling of comment suffixes in matrix rows and dynamic panels, ensuring they resolve correctly.
- Adjusted self-reference checks to account for matrix columns and template questions sharing names with top-level questions.

* feat: enhance linter functionality and metadata handling

- Implement runtime metadata reading for the linter, allowing dynamic analysis of registered properties and types.
- Introduce LintMetadata class to manage expression properties, trigger definitions, and element types.
- Update linter tests to validate new metadata functionality, including custom properties and composite components.
- Refactor existing tests to ensure compatibility with the new metadata-driven approach.
- Add tests for handling unknown types, expression properties, and custom conditions in the linter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* SSR hydration mismatch: SSR-stable element IDs (renderedIdSuffix) fix #11524

Auto-generated element IDs (sp_/sq_/comment/errors/aria/action ids) are now derived from a
per-survey id generator and wrapped via SurveyModel.getRenderedId (renderedIdPrefix/renderedIdSuffix),
so server and client renders produce identical DOM ids. Base delegates id namespacing to the survey
rather than knowing the prefix/suffix policy itself. Includes Angular ngOnInit override fix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix SSR hydration mismatch by ensuring renderedIdSuffix is set correctly in ngOnInit

* e2e: make comment id locators tolerate renderedIdSuffix

The comment DOM id is renderedId + "_comment", and renderedId can carry a survey-level
renderedIdSuffix (e.g. Vue 3.5 / React 18 useId), producing <name>[_<suffix>]_comment. Match on the
name prefix + _comment suffix so the assertions hold with or without a suffix.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Refactor element ID handling to use uniqueId and renderedId for consistency across components

* Remove settings.getElementId

* Refactor ActionContainer to manage locOwner and ensure deterministic SSR rendering

survey-core/linter - static analysis of survey logic (#11735)

* Add comprehensive linter tests for survey validation rules

- Implement tests for rendering findings in linter-renderer tests.
- Create linter rules tests covering various reference and naming issues.
- Add structure tests to validate page and element configurations.
- Introduce syntax tests for expression parsing and error reporting.
- Develop trigger tests to ensure proper validation of trigger targets.
- Add type mismatch tests to check for expression type compatibility.
- Implement walker tests to verify path normalization and index building.
- Create a TypeScript configuration for linter tests.

* Refactor linter to use Maps and Sets for type definitions and improve prototype key safety in CIMap and CIMultiMap

* Enhance linter to support dotted names in references and add corresponding tests

* feat(linter): enhance linting capabilities with new settings and function resolution

- Introduced ILintFunctionsProvider and ILintSettingsOverrides interfaces for better customization.
- Added resolveLintSettings and resolveLintFunctions functions to handle runtime options.
- Updated various linting rules to utilize new settings, improving type checking and choice validation.
- Enhanced expression type mismatch and unknown choice rules to support substring matching for scalar questions.
- Implemented tests for new functionalities, including custom suffix handling and imagemap question validation.
- Refactored existing linting logic to accommodate new settings structure and improve maintainability.

* fix(linter): lint validators declared with the full expressionvalidator type name

The runtime serializer accepts both "expression" and the full class name
"expressionvalidator", but the walker only recognized the short form, so
expressions in the long-form validators were silently never analyzed.

* fix(linter): detect trigger cycles that flow through a question valueName

Trigger edges were matched by raw strings, so a trigger setting "q1" never
linked to another trigger reading {v1} when v1 is the valueName of q1 -
a genuine runtime cascade went unreported. Both edge endpoints are now
canonicalized to the resolved element name.

* fix(linter): lint expressions inside composite component definitions

Elements passed via options.components elementsJSON were only harvested for
field names; their own visibleIf/enableIf/validator expressions were never
parsed or checked, so typos like {composite.fist} produced no diagnostics.
The walker now creates expression sites for definition elements with a
composite scope frame, finally constructing the previously dead
ScopeFrameComposite that the resolver already supported.

* fix(linter): report unknown trigger types instead of silently skipping them

A trigger whose type is not in the catalog was half-processed: only its
expression was scanned, while setToName targets, cycle detection, and extra
expression props were skipped without any signal. A misspelled type is also
silently dropped by the runtime. The new trigger/unknown-type rule reports
such triggers with a closest-match suggestion.

* refactor(linter): share duplicated helpers across rules

equalsCI and isKnownVariable had per-file copies, and the "which BinaryOperand
side is the Variable, which the constant" extraction was pasted three times
with diverging instanceof and operator checks. They now live in
expression-utils (matchVariableComparison, isPlainConst, getConstValues,
buildTriggerSetStep); choices-dead-source uses CIMultiMap.has instead of an
inline lowercase scan.

* fix(linter): parse reference indexes like the runtime ValueGetter

splitRefSegments claimed to mirror ValueGetter.getPath but read "[n]" indexes
with parseInt, so hex, comma decimals, exponents, and the >15-digit guard were
resolved differently than at runtime ({q[0x2]} meant index 2 for the engine and
0 for the linter). It now delegates to getPath. The import allowlist gains
conditionProcessValue, whose runtime dependencies are helpers and settings only,
so the linter still constructs no survey model.

* fix(linter): resolve trigger targets through the shared reference resolver

The rule reimplemented the byName/byValueName/calculatedValues/knownVariables
chain and its own indexed sub-path check, so it had already drifted from
classifyRef: dotted target names were falsely reported, and "-total"/"-Comment"
data keys resolved in expressions but not as trigger targets. Targets now go
through classifyTargetName, a name-mode entry point that skips expression-only
sugar (":" skipping, unwrap postfix, trailing ".length", scope prefixes) while
sharing the resolution chain and validateElementSubPath - which also extends
sub-path checking to multipletext, matrix, matrixdropdown, and component fields.
Navigation targets still resolve by name only, and suggestions stay kind-filtered.

Known gap: walker still derives trigger setRoot with a naive split, so dotted
setToName roots remain approximate for cycle/trigger canonicalization.

* refactor(linter): compute carry-forward paths at the report site

ChoicesInfo carried three path fields that were just record.path plus the
property name, and the walker set them only for selectbase questions - so
matrix columns fell back to the bare column path and reported their dead
carry-forward reference without naming the property. The paths are now
derived where they are reported, which removes the three fields and fixes
the column paths.

* refactor(linter): drop dead ElementRecord and ContainerRecord fields

ElementRecord.matrixColumnValues was declared but never written or read, and
ContainerRecord.json was populated at every container site while no rule ever
read it, pinning whole JSON subtrees for no consumer.

* refactor: streamline linter imports and settings handling

- Consolidated imports from "survey-core" in linter modules to reduce redundancy.
- Removed unnecessary interfaces for lint settings and functions, simplifying the configuration process.
- Updated lint settings resolution to directly use shared settings from "survey-core".
- Enhanced tests to utilize new settings handling, ensuring proper restoration after modifications.
- Added tests for legacy trigger expressions to ensure parity with runtime behavior.
- Introduced helper functions for managing settings and functions in tests, improving test clarity and maintainability.
- Updated Rollup configuration for linter to ensure proper external dependencies and typings.

* Refactor linter to support item-level conditions and improve carry-forward resolution

- Moved `choicesVisibleIf` and `choicesEnableIf` conditions to a new `MATRIX_COLUMN_ITEMVALUE_PROPS` for item-level evaluations in matrix columns.
- Enhanced `resolveCarryForwardSource` to handle row and panel prefixes, allowing for better resolution of choices in dynamic panels and matrix rows.
- Updated linter rules to correctly identify valid carry-forward sources and improve error reporting for dead sources.
- Added tests to ensure proper linting behavior for item-level conditions and carry-forward scenarios.
- Improved handling of comment suffixes in matrix rows and dynamic panels, ensuring they resolve correctly.
- Adjusted self-reference checks to account for matrix columns and template questions sharing names with top-level questions.

* feat: enhance linter functionality and metadata handling

- Implement runtime metadata reading for the linter, allowing dynamic analysis of registered properties and types.
- Introduce LintMetadata class to manage expression properties, trigger definitions, and element types.
- Update linter tests to validate new metadata functionality, including custom properties and composite components.
- Refactor existing tests to ensure compatibility with the new metadata-driven approach.
- Add tests for handling unknown types, expression properties, and custom conditions in the linter.

first parameter is a union, not an overload declaration, so an application
subclass that overrides the positional signature still compiles.

payload, not something a respondent can see or fix. clearIncorrectValues()
keeps removing unknown keys whatever the checks are.

the keys. survey.validationValueChecks supplies the default for the calls the
library makes itself.
